h1: Custom Gold Blankets for Events & Promotions
metaDescription: Order custom gold blankets for your next event. Perfect for awards, sports teams, and corporate gifts. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Gold blankets make a bold statement for corporate awards, sports championships, or VIP gift bags. Unlike standard fleece or polyester throws, the gold finish catches light and stands out in photos, making your logo or embroidered message pop. Available in plush fleece or woven styles, these blankets work well for outdoor events, trade show giveaways, or employee recognition programs. Choose screen-printed or embroidered decoration for a premium look that recipients will keep for years.
heroAltText: Custom gold blankets for corporate gifts and events with embroidered logo
